title: EU Data Act, Article 32: safeguards against third-country governmental access to non-personal data

answers.name: Obligation on data-processing providers to prevent unlawful third-country governmental access (Data Act Art. 32)
answers.description: Providers of data processing services must take adequate technical, organisational and legal measures to prevent international and third-country governmental access to, and transfer of, non-personal data held in the EU where this would conflict with EU or national law.
answers.sector: Data processing services, cloud and edge (W/120 1.B.c, CPC 843)

notes.nt_lfv: Applies to all providers, but compliance costs are higher for providers subject to foreign disclosure laws: evidence needed.
notes.x_paragraph: The data are non-personal, so (c)(ii) privacy does not fit; (c) compliance with EU rules on trade secrets/IP, (a) public order or XIV bis are possible routes.
notes._scenario: Illustrative inputs for research discussion, based on Regulation (EU) 2023/2854 as adopted.
